items.t: Car won't charge, with 12-volt and power warning lights
items.job: Replace on-board charger and DC-DC converter
items.note: Owners report about $5,000 for a replacement unit. Free if still inside the 10-year extended coverage.

items.t: Weak 12-volt battery: won't go READY or warning lights
items.note: One owner paid about $135 for a 151R battery; AGM types cost more.

items.t: Driving range drops as the main battery ages
items.note: Testing only. Owners report a used pack around $4,500 and much more for a new one.

items.t: Main battery won't fully charge or a cell fails
items.note: Testing only. Pack replacement is free inside coverage and very costly outside it.

items.t: Battery gauge doesn't show fully charged
Turtle mode from motor control unit fault (campaign)
items.job: Replace motor control unit under campaign
items.note: Free under service campaign SC-15-002 if your VIN is included.

items.t: Won't go into READY from inverter failure
items.note: One owner was quoted about $6,800 for the part and $300 to install it.

items.t: Won't go into READY in extreme cold
items.note: Covers diagnosis; the improved relay is extra.

items.t: Main battery cooling fan failure
items.note: Covers diagnosis; the fan is extra.

items.t: Rust on battery mounting bolts and ground points (campaign)
items.job: Inspect and treat rust under campaign
items.note: Free under service campaign SC-14-003 if your VIN is included.

items.t: Won't charge on some Clipper Creek chargers (campaign)
items.job: EV computer software update under campaign
items.note: Free under service campaign SC-13-001 if your VIN is included.

items.t: Quick charging stops or won't start
items.note: Covers diagnosis; ask whether the dealer charges for the software update.

items.t: Weak or no cabin heat
items.note: Covers diagnosis; a new heater unit costs extra.

items.t: Air conditioning stops working
items.note: Covers diagnosis; compressor or other parts cost extra.
